steps.title: No sign-in
steps.what: No sign-in: the mock config says you are signed in, so steps 2 to 5 are ready at once.

steps.title: Get an ID-JAG
steps.what: A sample ID-JAG comes back with the same request, response and spec-check table a real exchange produces.

steps.title: Redeem it
steps.what: A sample redemption returns a decoded access token. The scope dropdown lists the sample ID-JAG's scopes.

steps.title: Call the MCP server
steps.what: tools/list returns three sample tools; tools/call returns a sample result. The protected page renders a sample profile.

steps.title: Negative tests
steps.what: Each negative test returns a sample refusal so you can see what a pass looks like.
